title: Increase Limit on Existing-Customer Rent Increases and Reduction Notices: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Policy entry.** On a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, an existing-customer increase noticed for a rent above the increase limit is cut back to the limit with a reduction notice that points at the increase, keeps its effective date and carries the limit rent as its new rent; an increase at or below the limit is left as noticed.

**Standing of the agreement.** A reduction of a noticed increase is noticed only once the agreement stands in active status with no delinquency date on it. Stated in terms of the record: the reduction notice waits on an agreement whose status is active and whose delinquency date is empty.

| Noticed new rent compared with the limit rent | Outcome |
|---|---|
| above | cut back to the limit rent by a reduction notice |
| at or below | left as noticed |

## The reduction-notice tool

The reduction is noticed with the agent-side tool `reduce_unit_rate_increase_85726890`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. One call records one rent change notice, dated today, that points at the increase notice it reduces, keeps that increase's effective date and its rent before the change, and carries the reduced monthly rent as the new rent from that effective date; the agreement's current rent is not changed by the call. The tenant sees the reduced rent in the agreement's rent change history and in the notice sent.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_id` | the storage unit rental agreement number, read from the rental agreement lookup | identifier |
| `source_rate_change_id` | the rent change number of the existing-customer increase notice being reduced, read from the agreement's rent change lookup | identifier |
| `new_rent` | the reduced monthly rent from the increase's effective date, in US dollars | 2 decimal places; more places are rounded to the cent |

**Return.** The call succeeds when the receipt returns the new rent change number: `rate_change_id` (the new rent change number), `rental_id`, `source_rate_change_id` (the increase notice reduced), `change_reason` (always `increase_rescinded`), `previous_rent` (the rent before the increase), `new_rent` (the reduced rent), `notice_date` (today) and `effective_date` (the increase's effective date).
